title: Render directory resolves beneath scripts and omits cortex
evidence: REMOTION_DIR uses parent.parent of scripts/c5_demos source plus 01_KISH_ENGINE/transducers/video_remotion; this yields scripts/01_KISH_ENGINE/transducers/video_remotion, which does not exist. Actual entry and composition are under 01_KISH_ENGINE/cortex/transducers/video_remotion/src. Line 194 passes this path as subprocess cwd.
trigger: Invoke compilation on a cache miss after audio generation succeeds.
impact: Render subprocess fails before launching because its working directory is missing.

title: Concurrent compilations overwrite shared render inputs
evidence: All compilations use /tmp/c5_render; raw_audio_<scene.id>, master_audio_<scene.id>, concat_audio.txt, remotion_props.json and raw_remotion_video.mp4 have shared fixed names (114,127,153,168,184).
trigger: Run two compilations concurrently with distinct storyboards and matching scene IDs.
impact: One job can overwrite another job's audio, props or intermediate video, producing mixed output or failures.

title: Scene timing adds silence that the audio pipeline never emits
evidence: Scene video frames derive from ffprobe duration + 0.6 (122-124), but DSP uses amix duration=first with the unpadded voice input (137-140); concatenation joins those shorter audio files (153-160), and final mux uses -shortest (205).
trigger: Compile a multi-scene storyboard.
impact: Narration for later scenes advances before the corresponding visual boundary; final mux can truncate the last video scene.

title: Restore accepts snapshots larger than the configured capacity
evidence: restore replaces entries without comparing snapshot.len() to capacity; put evicts only one entry before adding one (51-62).
trigger: Restore a snapshot of three entries into a buffer of capacity two, then insert new keys.
impact: The advertised bounded buffer remains oversized indefinitely; callers cannot rely on capacity as a memory bound.

title: Zero-capacity KDA buffer still admits an entry
evidence: At capacity zero evict_lfu returns on an empty map (67-68), then put inserts unconditionally (55-62).
trigger: KdaMemoryBuffer::new(0).put("key", value).
impact: len becomes one despite a zero capacity; disabling storage via a zero quota is ineffective.

title: Hunter clears its risk window after every sample
evidence: Lines 59-65 append one sample then evaluate the buffer; both branches clear it at 68/72. CTRE computes a percentile over the supplied list.
trigger: Call scan_and_reconcile repeatedly on a new hunter.
impact: The advertised recent window never exceeds one observation; tail risk over the inference window is not measured.

title: Hunter reports on-chain commits without submitting transactions
evidence: The commit branch only increments executed_txs, clears a list and returns "Exergy injected on-chain"; the only Web3 operation is get_block at line 35.
trigger: Run the CLI with either a live RPC or no RPC and receive a COMMIT result.
impact: Operators receive fabricated transaction-success telemetry; the count records local decisions rather than on-chain effects. No execution bypass is alleged.

title: Gate receipts assert verified compliance without evaluating it
evidence: evaluate_and_seal only hashes tick/model/prompt and publishes a digest (62-89); it unconditionally emits EU_AI_ACT_COMPLIANT_ARTICLE_12_14_VERIFIED at 97. server.rs:139 calls this on request content and uses its seal in generated responses.
trigger: Any inference request for which publish succeeds.
impact: A receipt represents regulatory verification and attestation without policy checks, evidence validation, authority signature, or compliance evaluation. This is an unsupported runtime output claim, not evidence of a cryptographic authorization bypass.

title: Receipt hash does not distinguish model/prompt boundaries
evidence: The hash updates concatenate tick bytes, model bytes and prompt bytes at 66-68 without length prefixes or separators.
trigger: Two gates at the same tick evaluate (model="ab", prompt="c") and (model="a", prompt="bc").
impact: Different inference inputs yield identical prompt_hash and attestation_seal without a SHA-256 collision, undermining receipt input binding.

title: Unicast beeps cannot wake an already waiting agent
evidence: wait_for_beep awaits only _global_event, while beep_agent at lines 76-80 sets only _unicast_events[tenant_id]. The public methods use different events.
trigger: An agent starts awaiting wait_for_beep before beep_agent is called for its registered ID.
impact: The waiter remains suspended until an unrelated swarm broadcast, so addressed messages can stall indefinitely.

title: A swarm broadcast remains permanently pending for subsequent waits
evidence: beep_swarm sets _global_event at line 86; no method clears it. The fast path at lines 62-65 returns the same _global_payload without per-agent consumption.
trigger: Use the pager for two successive messages or wait again after consuming the first swarm broadcast.
impact: Subsequent waits return stale data immediately and never wait for a new broadcast; loops around this API can spin on the same payload.

title: Dry-run still overwrites the session artifact log
evidence: main always calls _generate_anagnorisis_log(registered, artifact_dir=artifact_dir); that function writes ANAGNORISIS_LOG.md without a dry_run guard (195-197).
trigger: Invoke --term X --dry-run --artifact-dir with an existing directory.
impact: A preview invocation creates or replaces the artifact log despite the CLI promise No escribir.

title: Phase replacement removes every section after Fase 2f
evidence: re.sub(r"\n\n### Fase 2f:.*", "", content, flags=re.DOTALL) consumes the entire remaining document.
trigger: Update a skill containing a generated Fase 2f followed by other sections.
impact: The update silently deletes all later skill instructions instead of replacing only the generated block.

title: Configured invalid signing seed silently switches identity
evidence: SigningKey(bytes.fromhex(seed)) is wrapped in broad except Exception that generates a fresh SigningKey, and anchor_payload then receives its public key (814).
trigger: A nonempty configured seed is malformed or has wrong length.
impact: Anchoring proceeds under an unexpected ephemeral identity instead of surfacing the signing-configuration error.

title: Updating an existing engine key creates stale eviction entries
evidence: Every store appends record_key to _keys even when _store already contains it; eviction at lines 28-30 removes the dictionary record for the oldest occurrence. query iterates duplicate _keys at lines 41-46.
trigger: With capacity=2, store a, update a, then store b.
impact: Eviction removes the current updated a record although another a entry remains, and queries before eviction return duplicate copies of the latest record.

title: YAML parser strips hash characters inside quoted strings
evidence: re.sub(r"#.*$", "", line_raw) runs before _parse_scalar processes quotes. parse_yaml is publicly reexported by primitives/__init__.py.
trigger: Parse a supported scalar such as color: "#ffffff" or value: "abc#def".
impact: Configuration strings are silently truncated, with quote fragments retained; valid quoted YAML scalar values cannot be represented reliably.

title: Server binds all interfaces despite announcing loopback
evidence: port is :1234, log announces 127.0.0.1, then http.ListenAndServe(port,mux); handler has no authentication (46–83).
trigger: Start the Go adapter on a host reachable from another machine.
impact: The mock chat endpoint is exposed on all interfaces contrary to its displayed local address; remote clients can submit arbitrary request bodies.

title: Claimed score lower-bound theorem omits necessary assumptions
evidence: THM-3 assumes G,L,E_base,B,P,M_p and speedup, but proof substitutes A=1 and E=0.04; AX-EX-1 defines E=max(E_base,T_w/100) and includes independent positive A (181–186).
trigger: Choose A sufficiently small, or T_w sufficiently large, while satisfying every stated THM-3 premise.
impact: Score can fall below 700, so the advertised theorem is not entailed by its premises; add the missing A and actual denominator bounds or narrow the conclusion.

title: Admitted result ignores publication failure after poison
evidence: audit_and_execute discards slot.publish Result at 228 and unconditionally returns Admitted at 230; publish returns PoisonedHalt at 103-104.
trigger: Call trigger_apoptosis(), then audit_and_execute with an otherwise qualifying inquiry.
impact: Example reports an admitted ticket and SAFE hash despite rejecting the capital update.

title: Verifier certifies attacker-controlled text without verifying any signature
evidence: Lines 62-103 only call content.contains; line 84 searches a hardware-signature label; lines 108-114 print absolute certification. The file imports only std. scripts/c5_demos/c5_sovereign_compliance_orchestrator.py:99-104 compiles and runs this CLI.
trigger: Pass --pack a plaintext file containing the searched labels, one quoted PASS token, and the two exact final status substrings, with no valid JSON, signature, chain, or proof.
impact: The demo reports a valid hardware signature, intact zero-knowledge proof, and absolute compliance for unauthenticated bytes; it cannot serve as an evidence verifier. No runtime authorization bypass is inferred.

title: Deployment script exits successfully after both publication commands fail
evidence: The gh repo create command falls back to git push; neither final failure is checked, and the last echo on line 14 determines a successful shell exit status. No set -e is present.
trigger: Repository creation and fallback push both fail (for example missing authorization or absent master branch).
impact: Caller receives exit 0 and BABYLON-60 Online despite no successful publication.

title: License gate treats conjunctive restrictive licenses as permissive alternatives
evidence: The parser splits only OR, then any permissive substring anywhere suppresses the restrictive result at line 73.
trigger: A dependency declares MIT AND GPL-3.0-only (or another conjunction containing permissive and restrictive licenses).
impact: The commercial distribution gate accepts a license expression whose restrictive obligations remain mandatory.

title: Garbage collection totals count repeated scans as reclaimable bytes
evidence: SHARUR_GC_000 and SHARUR_GC_006 repeat the same target/pattern, sample paths and bytes_found=640958858. Similar cycles repeat in all cohorts; total_anergy_bytes aggregates these repeats rather than identifying unique files.
trigger: Use total_anergy_bytes or cohort bytes as a storage evacuation/reclamation estimate.
impact: The historical report overcounts storage by counting the same files across agents; no actual deletion or consumer execution was established.

title: Git history verifier treats Git errors as a clean history
evidence: sh() runs git with check=False and returns only stdout (lines 31-35); exceptions also return an empty string. Lines 50-55 interpret empty output as no history.
trigger: git log fails (corrupt repository, inaccessible object database, missing Git, or invocation outside a repository containing the expected config files).
impact: Verifier can emit a green repository verdict without having successfully examined history, defeating the advertised secret-history check.

title: Kelly inputs do not constrain an approved bid
evidence: evaluate_bid rejects only zero probability/odds, then commits the entire proposed bid at lines 119-123. It never computes the Kelly fraction or validates probability <=10000. The claims sitrep labels Kelly bid caps verified.
trigger: Call evaluate_bid with an in-cap positive bid, win_prob_scaled=1 and positive odds (a negative-expectation wager).
impact: The exported budget gate returns Allowed and charges spend despite the promised Kelly constraint. No external auction execution was established; observed consumer src/bin/tamkarum.rs prints verdicts.

title: Do not copy authentication credentials into analytics dimensions
evidence: The full Worker example stores request.headers.get("x-api-key") verbatim as Analytics Engine index1.
trigger: A developer copies the example into a service authenticating with x-api-key.
impact: Raw credentials become analytics records accessible to analytics readers and retained beyond request processing. Use a nonsecret tenant ID or an irreversible identifier. No actual credential was read.

title: Relative transformation breaks the root-position invariant for subsequent transforms
evidence: r_transform([60,64,67], True) returns [60,64,69], False; p_transform assumes the second element is the minor third and increments it. Composition therefore yields [60,65,69] instead of an A-major pitch set [61,64,69]. generate_tonnetz_walk repeatedly feeds these arrays into transforms at lines 83-88.
trigger: Select the P-R alternating mode or any walk with a major R followed by minor P.
impact: The generated progression leaves the intended Neo-Riemannian transformations because inverted relative triads are interpreted as root-position triads.

title: Git publication auditor certifies history after scanning only 100 commits
evidence: Content scanning is git log -n 100 -p without --all, whereas success output claims all commits pass inspection at line 110. run_git errors also become empty text.
trigger: A secret in an ordinary source file exists only in older history or another branch.
impact: Pre-publication audit can issue a zero-leakage certificate while the historical content remains exposed.

title: License authority falls back to a publicly derivable signing key
evidence: Absent or wrong-length BABYLON_LICENSE_ED25519_SEED falls back to SHA-256 of a source-code literal (98-102), then output is labeled VALID_AUTHENTICATED_LICENSE (115).
trigger: Generate a certificate without an explicitly configured valid signing seed.
impact: Anyone with this source can derive the identical authority key and forge certificates signed with the default key. No runtime verifier consumer was established; finding applies to issued certificate authenticity.
